/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PaxDuviric.acquisition:
===Limited Time Event===
In the first two weeks after The Seven Crimes of Kullervo launched (June 21st, 2023 @ 12 PM ET until July 5th, 2023 @ 12 PM ET), entering Duviri via the Star Chart banner and Dormizone door would present all players with an event mission called Kullervo's Hold, which was based on The Lone Story's spiral-focused gameplay and always included the dungeon island in the Duviri Landscape regardless of the current Mood Spiral. This limited-time access required 5 Pathos Clamp.

===Normal Progression===
Kullervo's Hold only appears in Duviri during Anger, Sorrow, and Fear Spirals from The Duviri Experience and The Lone Story game modes. It can appear as a fourth, fifth, or sixth spiral stage or a side objective; speak with The Warden to engage in gladiatorial combat with the imprisoned Kullervo in the waterlogged arena.

Completion of the Spiral (defeating the Orowyrm) and defeating Kullervo awards 4, 5, or 6 Kullervo's Bane (6, 7, or 8 on The Steel Path), which can be traded to 30x30pxAcrithis for Rauta's main blueprint and components: the main blueprint requires 12 Banes, while the Barrel, Receiver, and Stock components each require 6 Banes, for a total of 30 Kullervo's Banes.
